title: Mobile Video - ICV - M500 - How To Set Up a Work Bench to Troubleshoot M500 DVRs Outside Vehicles
summary: Outlines the steps to configure a work bench testing environment for the M500 DVR using an AC/DC power harness (Part Number: WGP03274-KIT).
body: Created on: 2025-04-07 11:56:45 This article was updated •  Updated on: 2025-04-08 17:27:43 This article has 32 views. •  32 Views Product Categories • Tier 1: Mobile Video • Tier 2: In-Car Video • Tier 3: M500 • Tier 4: M500 DVR Visible to • Guest • Customer • Internal • Partner Issue - The M500 DVR requires a specific power setup for troubleshooting outside vehicles. - The customer requested guidance on configuring a work bench to power the M500 DVR for testing purposes. Environment - Product: M500 DVR - Category: In-Car Video Resolution 1. Obtain an AC/DC power harness designed for the M500 DVR by contacting the parts/repairs team at 1800-605-6734 option 2.  Part number for AC/DC power harness: WGP03274-KIT 2. Connect the AC/DC power harness to the M500 DVR. 3. Ensure the power harness is plugged into a compatible power source. 4. Verify that the DVR powers on successfully for testing.
